prompt:
Architecture delivery for the DAL estate. The separately managed point solutions in fixtures/estate-inventory.json must be brought under one VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 fleet, while a greenfield management-domain design is prepared for the target fleet. Build this as a PowerShell module named VcfFleetArchitecture. Treat VCF PowerCLI and the VMware.Sdk.Vcf modules as external deployment prerequisites; declare VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager and import it when available, but do not vendor, replace, or install VMware modules.

Before implementing, research current Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, release, and upgrade-path material for every product in the estate, including Live Site Recovery. Record the pages consulted in research-sources.json as objects with title, url, consultedAt, and usedFor. Use that research to determine the version paths and technical gates in the migration plan.

Export New-VcfFleetArchitecture from VcfFleetArchitecture/VcfFleetArchitecture.psd1. It must accept -InventoryPath and -OutputDirectory, read the inventory without modifying it, and write sddc-spec.json plus migration-plan.json into the output directory. Commit the module and the generated files under output/.

The greenfield output/sddc-spec.json must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. It must realize the greenfield requirements, including hosts, management components, networks, vSAN ESA, and distributed-switch uplinks. The existing-estate output/migration-plan.json must validate against schemas/migration-plan.schema.json, name every inventory component, preserve its current version, give its final target and complete version path, identify the technical gates that control its move, and order the moves consistently with the published compatibility and upgrade-path material.

The 28 Gbps north-south requirement must drive the plan's NSX Edge form factor. Preserve throughput after one Edge-node failure and lay out both 25 Gb uplinks on each Edge across the two named leaf switches with the required VLAN trunks and teaming policy. Do not replace this with prose: edgeDesign is part of migration-plan.json.

Run the acceptance check with: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1

research.interface: Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, release, and upgrade-path publications
